about.title: A printing equipment store built on four decades of service.
about.description: Since 1985, Tello Printing Center has supplied printers, photocopiers, printing supplies and document services to offices, workshops and institutions across Damascus. We help customers choose the right machine and keep it running.

story.title: Four decades of practical printing experience.

paragraphs.experience: What began as Tello Library on Amin Al-Rihani Street has grown into a complete printing equipment store. Our team combines product knowledge with hands-on service, so customers get clear advice before and after the sale.
paragraphs.choice: From a single desktop printer to a full office copier, inks, paper and spare parts, we stock the essentials and order the rest. We also print documents, drawings and plans for customers who need a reliable print partner.
